title: Stable-ASR Reference Collections
description: Curated upstream ASR projects that Stable-ASR should study, interoperate with, or benchmark against. This registry is a planning and attribution aid; it does not vendor upstream code.

entries.name: Kaldi
entries.focus: C++ ASR toolkit, recipes, WFST decoding, feature and data preparation conventions.
entries.reference_use: Study mature recipe structure, data preparation discipline, decoding terminology, and long-lived toolkit governance.

entries.name: ESPnet
entries.focus: End-to-end speech processing recipes across ASR, TTS, speech translation, enhancement, diarization, and SLU.
entries.reference_use: Study reproducible recipe layout, multi-task speech abstractions, and benchmark reporting style.

entries.name: WeNet
entries.focus: Production-oriented streaming and non-streaming end-to-end ASR toolkit.
entries.reference_use: Study streaming deployment APIs, runtime boundaries, and production-first project shape.

entries.name: FunASR
entries.focus: Industrial ASR toolkit with VAD, ASR, punctuation, diarization, emotion, streaming, and service deployment.
entries.reference_use: Study industrial Chinese ASR ergonomics, streaming service interfaces, and one-call speech understanding APIs.

entries.name: FireRedASR2S
entries.focus: Industrial all-in-one ASR system with ASR, VAD, LID, punctuation, Mandarin dialects, English, code-switching, and singing ASR support.
entries.reference_use: Study Chinese-first system outputs, word timestamps, VAD segments, language labels, and JSONL export shape for interaction-level evaluation.

entries.name: Qwen3-ASR
entries.focus: Open-source multilingual ASR model family with language detection, timestamp prediction, streaming demos, vLLM deployment, and forced alignment utilities.
entries.reference_use: Track modern speech-LLM ASR output contracts, timestamp behavior, multilingual robustness, and command-backed benchmark recipes.

entries.name: SenseVoice
entries.focus: Multilingual speech understanding model covering ASR, language identification, emotion recognition, audio event detection, and service deployment.
entries.reference_use: Study rich transcription outputs and auxiliary speech-understanding signals that may affect turn/action policies.

entries.name: NVIDIA NeMo Speech
entries.focus: Scalable Speech AI framework for ASR, TTS, diarization, model training, fine-tuning, and deployment paths.
entries.reference_use: Study large-model ASR configuration, pretrained checkpoint handling, and deployment-oriented reporting.

entries.name: SpeechBrain
entries.focus: PyTorch speech toolkit with broad recipes, pretrained models, tutorials, and conversational AI tasks.
entries.reference_use: Study tutorial quality, recipe consistency, pretrained model ergonomics, and broad task taxonomy.

entries.name: Lhotse
entries.focus: Speech and multimodal data preparation, manifests, cuts, supervision, and corpus recipes.
entries.reference_use: Study robust manifest design, corpus preparation recipes, and data-layer interoperability.

entries.name: icefall
entries.focus: ASR recipes and training examples built around k2, lhotse, transducers, CTC, and Zipformer-style models.
entries.reference_use: Study modern transducer recipes, export paths, and Lhotse-centered corpus handling.

entries.name: sherpa-onnx
entries.focus: Offline-capable ONNX runtime for ASR, TTS, diarization, VAD, embedded systems, mobile, and WebSocket use.
entries.reference_use: Study deployable ASR runtime APIs, ONNX packaging, streaming examples, and embedded constraints.

entries.name: whisper.cpp
entries.focus: C/C++ Whisper inference runtime for CPU, embedded, mobile, server, WebAssembly, and low-dependency deployment.
entries.reference_use: Study portable runtime packaging, quantization-facing reports, command-line transcript export, and edge latency measurement.

entries.name: OpenAI Whisper
entries.focus: General-purpose multilingual ASR and speech translation model family.
entries.reference_use: Study model cards, transcription API shape, timestamp behavior, and robust multilingual baseline expectations.

entries.name: WhisperX
entries.focus: Whisper-based ASR pipeline with word-level timestamps, forced alignment, VAD, and speaker diarization.
entries.reference_use: Study word timestamp stability, diarization-aware transcript outputs, and long-form alignment evaluation.

entries.name: faster-whisper
entries.focus: Whisper inference implementation using CTranslate2 for faster transcription.
entries.reference_use: Study practical Whisper deployment, batched inference, quantization, and latency-sensitive transcription.

entries.name: Moonshine
entries.focus: Low-latency on-device speech-to-text toolkit and model family designed for live voice interfaces and constrained deployments.
entries.reference_use: Study streaming transcript events, bounded-latency ASR design, and edge-device benchmark reporting.

entries.name: WhisperKit
entries.focus: On-device Whisper deployment stack for Apple platforms using Core ML and native Swift APIs.
entries.reference_use: Study mobile/on-device ASR benchmarking, Core ML export conventions, and real-time UX constraints.

entries.name: Hugging Face Transformers ASR
entries.focus: ASR pipelines, fine-tuning guides, model hub integration, and many pretrained ASR architectures.
entries.reference_use: Study adapter conventions for hub models, training/evaluation examples, and model-card workflows.
